method.network: CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions on page and attached service worker
method.cpu: page main thread 4x slowdown, not a calibrated physical phone
method.scope: Anonymous Japanese hard navigations, 390x844 CSS px, DPR 1. No app changes or deployment.
method.sampling: Home 3 serial cold/warm pairs per profile; auth/admin/about one pair each at 1.6Mbps. Cold uses fresh Chrome profile. Warm follows completed SW precache in same profile; not HTTP-cache-only.
method.observation: At least 5s after UI marker, eight catalog resource response bodies completed, SW controlling. Metrics snapshot before any click/scroll.
method.transfer: Sum of observed CDP encodedDataLength, excluding responses served from SW/disk/memory cache. Includes response header bytes; not TLS packet accounting. Page and SW budgets are CDP-target emulation, not one globally shaped physical link. Early SW bootstrap traffic may precede attachment.
method.lcp: Last largest-contentful-paint entry in observation window. Not field p75.
method.cls: Maximum 5s session window with less than 1s gaps; recent-input shifts excluded. Not full visit lifecycle.
method.ready: Home direct input button / auth email / admin email / about heading appears, then two animation frames. Does not assert completed authentication or every route operation.
method.catalog: Eight response bodies finished; not a separate measurement of validation/install completion.
method.interaction: Home dialog open after resources settle: CDP mouse dispatch to two frames after input exists. Includes command overhead. Not INP or TTI.
method.exclusions: Smoke trials with observer errors, CPU-overlapping builds/browsers or incomplete final catalog bodies were excluded. Only directories selected for this summary were used.
method.catalogMetadata: Immutable pinned release metadata independently read and matched to captured version queries; original raw evidence retained. Normalized copies add metadata without changing timings.
